findings.description: The 'Mail connected' state shows only meeting to-dos in the To do card. The story is about one list that mixes mail to-dos and meeting to-dos, and how the user tells them apart (plan: only the detail line differs).
findings.expected: Card shows at least one mail to-do (with sender and reason) next to meeting to-dos.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one mail to-do to the 'Mail connected' state.
